articles.summary: eBay launches Easy and Free Returns on eligible vehicle parts and accessories, helping buyers shop with greater confidence New programme applies to eligible purchases over £10, working alongside eBay Assured Fit Eligible parts and accessories can be returned within 30 days of delivery at no additional cost to the buyer Buyers can access free return labels plus scheduled pick-ups or easy drop-offs to fit any schedule eBay, the number one online marketplace for vehicle parts and accessories in the UK, has launched Easy and Free Returns to give customers greater confidence when buying eligible new parts online.
articles.title: eBay Launches Easy and Free Returns for Vehicle Parts and Accessories in the UK
